body:
New NORTHSTAR.md section for a real mod registry ('like npm but mo betta'), naming real gaps individually (no name/version scheme, no registry backend, no publish/install CLI, no dependency resolution, no VS0/BURROW compiler-version compatibility story) against the real, already-shipped dlopen/dlsym mods-manifest foundation MODDING.md documents. Real 4-phase plan (A: version field -> B: IDUNA-hosted registry endpoint modeled on the existing Apples ledger -> C: real publish/install CLI -> D: dependency resolution if actually needed). Phase A shipped for real this same pass: --mods-manifest's pipe-delimited format gains an optional third |version field (so_path|function[|version]); an omitted field defaults to PC_MOD_VERSION_UNVERSIONED, every manifest written before this pass keeps working byte-for-byte unchanged. Live-verified: built apps/server via bazel, ran with a real mixed manifest (one versioned line, one bare pre-existing-format line) against the live worldapi backend -- startup log correctly reported 'on_papercraft_xp_for_object_destroyed@1.2.3' and 'xp_required_for_level@0.0.0-unversioned' respectively. bazel test //packages/simulation/...: 15/15 pass, zero regressions; bazel build //apps/server/... clean. Commit 4097a00. Honest, named gap: CHANGELOG.md not updated -- the same real, pre-existing POSIX ACL bug found earlier this session (owner treeiii, mask caps fatbaby's effective permission to read-only) still blocks writing to it; sudo-queue/46-fix-papercraft-changelog-acl.sh remains queued, not yet run.

⚓ ☃
title: Mod registry NORTHSTAR scoping + real Phase A (versioned mods-manifest) shipped (43432)
